hero_sub: Subtle elegance, coastal tranquility, and curated Georgian hospitality nestled where subtropical emerald hills meet the calm sea.
intro_h1: Where Ancient Terroir Meets the Rhythm of the Black Sea
intro_p: Perched along the protected waters of Gonio's shoreline, FC GONIO was conceived as an architectural retreat. Stripped of superficial excess, our sanctuary harmonizes clean Mediterranean lines with the time-honored warmth of Georgian hospitality.
intro_quote: "In Gonio, the sea does not simply lap the shore — it sets the tempo for quiet reflection, private celebration, and restoration."
pillar_arch_b: Natural travertine, light oak, and floor-to-ceiling panoramic glass.
pillar_view_b: Every living space commands a sweeping vista of the sea or sub-tropical hills.
pillar_conc_b: Private yacht charters, Adjarian vineyard trails, personal wellness schedules.
pillar_food_b: Artisanal breakfasts featuring regional alpine cheeses, wild mountain honey, and seaside pastries.
suites_sub: Generous private sanctuaries styled in warm organic textures, expansive verandas, and panoramic sea vistas.
s1_desc: Floor-to-ceiling glass doors opening to the ocean breeze. Fitted with natural oak cabinetry, linen draping, and an expansive sunset lounge.
s2_desc: A generous living area with wrap-around views, hand-woven Georgian textile accents, and a private plunge terrace above the sea.
s3_desc: Set amid subtropical gardens with a private stone terrace, outdoor daybed, and direct garden access — serene and utterly secluded.
fac_p: Every facility at FC GONIO has been conceived as an extension of the suite — a continuation of the calm, restorative atmosphere that defines our coastal sanctuary.
fac_pool_b: Cascading infinity edge with direct Black Sea panorama. Heated season-round.
fac_spa_b: Georgian mineral baths, hammam rituals, and bespoke aromatherapy treatments.
fac_dining_b: Open-air table service with Adjarian wine pairings and freshly caught Black Sea seafood.
fac_gym_b: Floor-to-ceiling glazing, Technogym equipment, and in-room yoga programming on request.
loc_h1: Where History Meets the Sea — Gonio, Batumi
loc_p: Situated just south of central Batumi, Gonio has celebrated its pristine marine microclimate since Roman antiquity. The historic Gonio-Apsaros Fortress stands minutes away, while our seaside boulevard offers quiet morning strolls away from downtown commotion.
loc_address: Gonio Seaside Promenade, Autonomous Republic of Adjara, Georgia
cta_h1: Reserve Your Corner of the Black Sea
cta_p: Our reservation team is available around the clock to craft a bespoke itinerary that matches your vision of the perfect coastal retreat.
footer_desc: An architectural haven perched along the Black Sea coastline. Curated hospitality, serene maritime living, and discreet luxury in Batumi, Georgia.

why_desc: Discover a welcoming place to stay, where comfort, a remarkable location and the warmth of Georgian hospitality come together. Experience a stay designed around the things that matter most.
why_f1_desc: Discover the beauty of Gonio and enjoy the atmosphere of Georgia's Black Sea coast.
why_f2_desc: Thoughtfully designed accommodation focused on making every stay comfortable.
why_f3_desc: A warm welcome inspired by Georgia's long-standing tradition of hospitality.
why_f4_desc: Attentive care and a welcoming atmosphere throughout your stay.
why_subtitle: A PLACE TO FEEL AT HOME
sp_p: Framed by floor-to-ceiling glass, natural travertine masonry, and bleached oak millwork, every residence provides an uninterrupted sensory dialogue with the Black Sea horizon.

fac_title: Everything you need for a comfortable stay
fac_intro: A simple, well-located hotel 300 m from the sea. Breakfast is included, and the boulevard is just 50 m away.
fac_d1: Served every morning in our sea-view restaurant.
fac_d2: Large windows with views of the sea and Batumi Boulevard.
fac_d3: Friendly front desk and a comfortable seating area.
fac_d4: Shower, hairdryer, toiletries and fresh towels.
fac_d5: Internet in rooms and common areas.
fac_d6: The hotel has no private parking. Ask us about the nearest options.
